يحتقبن (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِبْنَ (yaḥtaqibna) /jaħ.ta.qib.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# يُحْتَقَبْنَ (yuḥtaqabna) /juħ.ta.qab.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
